mapper.select: SELECT biz_info_seq , office_seq , corp_code, ceo_name , biz_reg_file , biz_reg_no ,biz_workplace_no , biz_corp_name , biz_addr , biz_addr_detail , biz_fax_no , biz_tel_no , biz_post_no , biz_type , biz_kind , reg_discount_code , year_discount_code , discount_closing_date as discount_closing_date, create_user , create_at , del_yn , note FROM utb_biz_info WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY create_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offSet}

SELECT biz_info_seq , office_seq , corp_code , ceo_name , biz_reg_no , biz_corp_name , biz_addr , biz_addr_detail , biz_fax_no , biz_tel_no , biz_post_no , biz_type , biz_kind , reg_discount_code , year_discount_code , TO_CHAR(discount_closing_date, 'YYYYMMDD') as discount_closing_date , reduction_reason , TO_CHAR(reduction_issue_date, 'YYYYMMDD') as reduction_issue_date, create_user , create_at , del_yn , note FROM utb_biz_info WHERE biz_info_seq = #{bizInfoSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_biz_info SET del_yn = 'Y', update_user = #{userId}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE biz_info_seq = #{bizInfoSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'

UPDATE utb_biz_info SET corp_code = #{corpCode}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, biz_reg_no = #{bizRegNo}, biz_workplace_no = #{bizWorkplaceNo}, biz_corp_name = #{bizCorpName}, biz_addr = #{bizAddr}, biz_addr_detail = #{bizAddrDetail}, biz_fax_no = #{bizFaxNo}, biz_tel_no = #{bizTelNo}, biz_post_no = #{bizPostNo}, biz_type = #{bizType}, biz_kind = #{bizKind}, reg_discount_code = #{regDiscountCode}, year_discount_code = #{yearDiscountCode}, discount_closing_date = NULLIF(#{discountClosingDate}, '')::timestamptz, reduction_reason = #{reductionReason}, reduction_issue_date = NULLIF(#{reductionIssueDate}, '')::timestamptz, biz_contact_name = #{bizContactName}, biz_dept_name = #{bizDeptName}, biz_email = #{bizEmail}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, note = #{note} WHERE biz_info_seq = #{bizInfoSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq}
